content: Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
author: Seneca
story:
There is a sharp, grounded clarity in this observation. Living in pretense takes an enormous amount of mental energy. When you constantly manage impressions to please others, you end up feeling like an imposter in your own skin.

Seneca understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Honesty with yourself can feel uncomfortable at first, but it is the only ground upon which a real life can be built. When you stop lying to yourself about your feelings, your energy is immediately freed up.
reflectionPrompt: What capability, skill, or discipline can you sharpen in quiet preparation today so you are ready when your breakthrough opportunity arrives?
